stage: question-first editorial draft before local candidate tables
independence: Author saw legacy and prior packet; not blind or independently validated. Fresh held-out probes must come from another reviewer.

questions.text: What physical body is meant by the Earth in this observation?
questions.interpretation_seed: Planet identity vs region vs material sample.

questions.text: Does a plate contain only crust or also upper mantle?
Where does the crust end beneath this place?
questions.interpretation_seed: Boundary inferred from wave response; not arbitrary map border.

questions.text: What distinguishes a water body from the region surrounding it?
questions.interpretation_seed: Material body vs volumetric geographical region.

questions.text: Can a coastal strip be identified without classifying every land-cover pixel?
questions.interpretation_seed: Shared geographic bearer vs authority classification.

questions.text: Is this hill lower because material left it or because our datum changed?
questions.interpretation_seed: Erosion-driven elevation change vs representation correction.

questions.text: Did rock break down in place or move elsewhere?
Where did the sediment on this fan come from?
questions.interpretation_seed: Material provenance needs transport occurrence, not mere proximity.

questions.text: Can slow uplift and erosion happen at the same time?
questions.interpretation_seed: Competing occurrents, not mutually exclusive predicates.

questions.text: Was this slope movement one bounded episode?
What changed when a new rock deposit formed?
questions.interpretation_seed: Deposition, deposited material and bearer extent distinguished.

questions.text: Is a river reach a body of water or a geographical corridor?
questions.interpretation_seed: Persistent place vs changing material body needs split.

questions.text: Does every visible land boundary mark a geological difference?
questions.interpretation_seed: Administrative/land-use authority categories do not entail geology.

questions.text: Can earthquake measurements tell us about inaccessible layers?
questions.interpretation_seed: Observable meaning vs observational method/inverse model.

questions.text: If elevation change is unresolved after erosion, may the twin continue?
questions.interpretation_seed: Unknown change remains unresolved; not zero change or retention rule.
